entities.summary: Francis Lee Johnson was an American basketball player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics in Berlin. He was born and raised in Hartford, Kansas and is a graduate of Hartford High School. Francis Johnson was a athletes & competitors from Hartford (1910-08-05, Hartford–1997-04-18).
